name: Generate PRN and source ref number for government remittance doctype
script:
#Generate Source Ref Number
if not doc.source_ref_number:
    now = str(frappe.utils.now_datetime())
    
    timestamp = (
        now[2:4] +
        now[5:7] +
        now[8:10] +
        now[11:13] +
        now[14:16] +
        now[17:19]
    )
    
    # Last two digits of the microseconds
    random_part = now[-2:]
    
    doc.source_ref_number = "MITC" + timestamp + random_part


# Generate PRN
if doc.is_mra_remittance:

    if not doc.prn:

        now = str(frappe.utils.now_datetime())

        timestamp = (
            now[2:4] +   # YY
            now[5:7] +   # MM
            now[8:10] +  # DD
            now[11:13] + # HH
            now[14:16] + # MM
            now[17:19]   # SS
        )

        # Last 4 digits of the microseconds
        unique_part = now[-4:]

        doc.prn = "MITCPRN" + timestamp + unique_part

name: Generate TRF number on payroll entry
script:
if not doc.custom_trf_source_ref_number:

    ts = frappe.utils.now().split(".")[0]

    source_ts = (
        ts[8:10] +   # DD
        ts[5:7] +    # MM
        ts[0:4] +    # YYYY
        ts[11:13] +  # HH
        ts[14:16] +  # MM
        ts[17:19]    # SS
    )

    payroll_id = doc.name.replace("-", "")

    doc.custom_trf_source_ref_number = payroll_id + source_ts

name: Generate source ref number and get employee bank details for Salary slips
script:
# Populate Bank details for individual employee
if doc.employee:
    bank_bic = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Employee",
        doc.employee,
        "custom_bank_bic"
    )

    if bank_bic:
        doc.custom_bank_bic = bank_bic
        
        
# Generate source_ref_number for individual employee salary slips
if not doc.custom_source_ref_number:
    now = str(frappe.utils.now_datetime())
    date_part = now[8:10] + now[5:7] + now[2:4]   # DDMMYY
    time_part = now[11:13] + now[14:16] + now[17:19]  # HHMMSS
    
    # Employee ID without hyphens
    employee_part = doc.employee.replace("-", "")

    doc.custom_source_ref_number = (
        "001459"
        + date_part
        + time_part
        + employee_part
    )
    

# Populate Cost Center from Payroll Entry
if doc.payroll_entry:

    cost_center = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Payroll Entry",
        doc.payroll_entry,
        "cost_center"
    )

    if cost_center:
        doc.custom_cost_center = cost_center.replace("-", " ")

name: Generate OBDX salary file
script:
payroll_entries = json.loads(frappe.form_dict.payroll_entries)

if not payroll_entries:
    frappe.throw("No Payroll Entries selected")

placeholders = ", ".join(["%s"] * len(payroll_entries))

query = f"""
SELECT
    `tabPayroll Entry`.`name` AS sort_id,
    0 AS is_child,
    '001459' AS vote_number,

    ROUND(
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT SUM(net_pay)
                FROM `tabSalary Slip`
                WHERE `tabSalary Slip`.`payroll_entry` = `tabPayroll Entry`.`name`
            ),
            0
        ),
        2
    ) AS total_amount,

    `tabPayroll Entry`.`currency` AS currency, /* remain the same */
    `tabPayroll Entry`.`custom_salary_debit_rbm_account_number` AS debit_Acc_no, /* custom_salary_debit_rbm_account_number */
    
    `tabPayroll Entry`.`custom_trf_source_reference_number` AS source_ref_number, /* from government remittance source ref number */
    
    CONCAT('Payroll Entry Generated From ERPNext ', `tabPayroll Entry`.`name`) AS description, /* remain the same for now */
    DATE_FORMAT(`tabPayroll Entry`.`posting_date`, '%%d.%%m.%%Y') AS posting_date, /* remain the same */
    LPAD(`tabPayroll Entry`.`number_of_employees`, 4, '0') AS total_count /* remain the same */

FROM `tabPayroll Entry`

WHERE `tabPayroll Entry`.`name` IN ({placeholders})

UNION ALL

SELECT
    `tabSalary Slip`.`payroll_entry` AS sort_id,
    1 AS is_child,
    `tabSalary Slip`.`custom_bank_bic`, /* custom_bank_bic */
    `tabSalary Slip`.`bank_account_no`, /* stay the same */
    `tabSalary Slip`.`custom_source_ref_number`, /* change to custom_source_ref_number */
    `tabSalary Slip`.`employee_name`, /* stay the same */
    `tabSalary Slip`.`bank_name`, /* stay the same */
    'MITC Main', /* Cost Center */ /* should be; MITC Main, for now*/ 
    'TEST SALARY PAYMENT', /* Description */ /* should remain the same for now */
    ROUND(`tabSalary Slip`.`net_pay`, 2) /* Amount */ /*should remain the same */

FROM `tabSalary Slip`

WHERE `tabSalary Slip`.`payroll_entry` IN ({placeholders})

ORDER BY sort_id, is_child
"""

data = frappe.db.sql(
    query,
    tuple(payroll_entries) * 2
)

csv_content = ""

for row in data:

    cleaned_row = []

    for i, value in enumerate(row):

        if value is None:
            cleaned_row.append("")

        else:

            # Amount fields
            if (
                (row[0] and row[1] == 0 and i == 3)
                or
                (row[0] and row[1] == 1 and i == 9)
            ):
                text = "%.2f" % float(value)

            else:
                text = str(value)

            text = text.replace(";", "")
            text = text.replace("\n", " ")
            text = text.replace("\r", " ")
            text = text.replace("-", "")
            text = text.replace("_", "")

            cleaned_row.append(text)

    # Remove sort_id column from export
    cleaned_row = cleaned_row[1:]

    csv_content += ";".join(cleaned_row) + "\n"

frappe.response["type"] = "download"

timestamp = frappe.utils.now().replace("-", "").replace(":", "").replace(" ", "")[:14]

frappe.response["filename"] = (
    "IFMISSP_001400085_" + timestamp + "_UNSIGNED" + ".csv"
)

frappe.response["filecontent"] = csv_content

name: Generate source ref number and auto populate obdx normal payment item
script:
# Generate Source Reference Number
if not doc.source_ref_number:

    now = str(frappe.utils.now_datetime())

    # YYMMDD
    date_part = now[2:4] + now[5:7] + now[8:10]

    # HHMMSS
    time_part = now[11:13] + now[14:16] + now[17:19]

    doc.source_ref_number = (
        "MITCPM"
        + date_part
        + time_part
    )


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Populate fields when Party Type = Supplier
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

if doc.party_type == "Supplier" and doc.party_name:

    supplier = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Supplier",
        doc.party_name,
        [
            "supplier_name",
            "custom_vendor_code"
        ],
        as_dict=True
    )

    if supplier:

        doc.vendor_code = supplier.custom_vendor_code
        doc.bene_name = supplier.supplier_name

        # Fixed values
        doc.national_id = "MITCPMN"
        doc.employee_number = "MITC"


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Populate fields when Party Type = Employee
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

elif doc.party_type == "Employee" and doc.party_name:

    employee = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Employee",
        doc.party_name,
        [
            "employee_name",
            "employee_number",
            "custom_national_id_number"
        ],
        as_dict=True
    )

    if employee:

        doc.bene_name = employee.employee_name

        doc.employee_number = employee.employee_number

        # Employee number is also Vendor Code and Invoice Number
        doc.vendor_code = employee.employee_number
        doc.invoice_number = employee.employee_number

        doc.national_id = employee.custom_national_id_number

name: Generate OBDX Normal Payment CSV
script:
payment_batches = json.loads(frappe.form_dict.payment_batches)

if not payment_batches:
    frappe.throw("No OBDX Payment Batches selected")

placeholders = ", ".join(["%s"] * len(payment_batches))

query = f"""
SELECT
    0 AS is_child,
    /* `tabOBDX Payment Batch`.`file_ref_code`, */
    `tabOBDX Payment Batch`.`name` AS file_ref_code,
    `tabOBDX Payment Batch`.`trans_currency`,

    ROUND(
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT SUM(amount)
                FROM `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`
                WHERE `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`parent`
                    = `tabOBDX Payment Batch`.`name`
            ),
            0
        ),
        2
    ) AS total_amount,

    LPAD(
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`
            WHERE `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`parent`
                = `tabOBDX Payment Batch`.`name`
        ),
        4,
        '0'
    ) AS total_count,

    NULL AS payment_amount,          /* 6 */
    NULL AS payee_details,           /* 7 */
    NULL AS vendor_code,             /* 8 */
    NULL AS employee_number,         /* 9 */
    NULL AS national_id,             /* 10 */
    NULL AS invoice_number,          /* 11 */
    NULL AS payee_bic,               /* 12 */
    NULL AS credit_account_number,   /* 13 */
    NULL AS cost_center,             /* 14 */
    NULL AS payment_date,            /* 15 */
    NULL AS source_reference_number, /* 16 */
    NULL AS description              /* 17 */

FROM `tabOBDX Payment Batch`

WHERE `tabOBDX Payment Batch`.`name` IN ({placeholders})

UNION ALL

SELECT
    1 AS is_child,

    LPAD(
        `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`idx`,
        4,
        '0'
    ),

    `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`currency`,

    `tabOBDX Payment Batch`.`debit_acc_num`,

    `tabOBDX Payment Batch`.`debit_acc_name`,

    ROUND(
        `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`amount`,
        2
    ),

    `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`bene_name`,

    `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`vendor_code`,

    `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`employee_number`,

    `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`national_id`,

    `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`invoice_number`,

    `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`bene_bank_bic`,

    `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`bene_account_num`,

    `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`cost_center`,

    DATE_FORMAT(
        `tabOBDX Payment Batch`.`payment_date`,
        '%%d.%%m.%%Y'
    ),

    `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`source_ref_number`,

    `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`payment_description`

FROM `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`

INNER JOIN `tabOBDX Payment Batch`
    ON `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`parent`
        = `tabOBDX Payment Batch`.`name`

WHERE `tabOBDX Normal Payment Reference`.`parent`
    IN ({placeholders})

ORDER BY is_child
"""

data = frappe.db.sql(
    query,
    tuple(payment_batches) * 2
)

# Properly sort rows
#
# Parent rows (0) first
# Child rows (1) ordered by 0001, 0002, etc.

sorted_data = sorted(
    data,
    key=lambda row: (
        row[0],
        int(row[1])
        if row[0] == 1 and str(row[1]).isdigit()
        else 0
    )
)

csv_content = ""

for row in sorted_data:

    cleaned_row = []

    for i, value in enumerate(row):

        if value is None:

            cleaned_row.append("")

        else:

            # Parent total amount
            if row[0] == 0 and i == 3:

                text = "%.2f" % float(value)

            # Child payment amount
            elif row[0] == 1 and i == 5:

                text = "%.2f" % float(value)

            else:

                text = str(value)

            # Remove characters that can interfere with CSV
            text = text.replace(";", "")
            text = text.replace("\n", " ")
            text = text.replace("\r", " ")

            # Remove hyphens and underscores
            text = text.replace("-", "")
            text = text.replace("_", "")

            cleaned_row.append(text)

    # Parent rows:
    # Keep is_child + first 4 data fields
    if row[0] == 0:
        cleaned_row = cleaned_row[:5]

    csv_content += ";".join(cleaned_row) + "\n"


frappe.response["type"] = "download"

# Generate filename
timestamp = (
    frappe.utils.now()
    .replace("-", "")
    .replace(":", "")
    .replace(" ", "")[:14]
)

frappe.response["filename"] = (
    "OBDXPMN_001400085_"
    + timestamp
    + "_UNSIGNED.csv"
)

frappe.response["filecontent"] = csv_content
